title: Race Conditions: TOCTOU and double-spend
description: Exploit unlocked check-then-act: redeem one coupon 9 times, break daily limits and drive the balance negative with real parallel requests.

race-condition-t01-q01.prompt: What acronym describes the check-then-act vulnerability (check one thing, use another)?

race-condition-t01-q02.prompt: Redeem WELCOME10 with 15 SEQUENTIAL requests (one after another). How many uses does the server record at the end? (check /status)

race-condition-t01-q03.prompt: Now fire 15 PARALLEL requests at /redeem?code=WELCOME10. Submit the DOUBLE_SPEND achievement flag.

race-condition-t02-q01.prompt: What Python primitive does /buy-safe use to make check and act atomic?

race-condition-t02-q02.prompt: Break the daily purchase limit (max 3) until purchases > 13. Submit the LIMIT_BYPASS achievement flag.

race-condition-t02-q03.prompt: Drive the balance negative by exploiting /checkout. Submit the NEGATIVE_BALANCE achievement flag.
